events.title: Fatherland
events.description: OPENS NOVEMBER 20 | In 1949, the writer Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler), returning from sixteen years of exile in the US, and his daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller) drive across a divided Germany, from the Allied-occupied city of Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
